1	/**
2	 * Caché LRU en Redis (RAM compartida entre instancias).
3	 *
4	 * Índice ZSET por namespace (score = último acceso) + valor STRING.
5	 * Al superar maxEntries se expulsa con ZPOPMIN (menor score = menos reciente).
6	 *
7	 * En producción conviene además `maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru` en el servidor Redis.
8	 */
9	
10	import { createHash } from 'crypto';
11	import type { Redis } from 'ioredis';
12	import {
13	  getCacheNamespacePolicy,
14	  type CacheNamespace,
15	} from '@/lib/cache-namespace-policy';
16	import type { LruSetOptions, LruStats, LruStoreConfig } from '@/lib/lru-cache-store';
17	import { getLruStoreConfigFromEnv } from '@/lib/lru-cache-store';
18	
19	/** Hash tag por namespace — operaciones MULTI en el mismo slot (Redis Cluster). */
20	function hashTag(namespace: string): string {
21	  return `{ps:cache:${namespace}}`;
22	}
23	
24	function hashKey(key: string): string {
25	  return createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);
26	}
27	
28	function valueKey(namespace: string, key: string): string {
29	  return `${hashTag(namespace)}:val:${hashKey(key)}`;
30	}
31	
32	function indexKey(namespace: string): string {
33	  return `${hashTag(namespace)}:lru`;
34	}
35	
36	function maxEntriesFor(namespace: string): number {
37	  try {
38	    return getCacheNamespacePolicy(namespace as CacheNamespace).maxEntries;
39	  } catch {
40	    return getLruStoreConfigFromEnv().maxEntries;
41	  }
42	}
43	
44	export type RedisLruPayload =
45	  | { kind: 'buffer'; data: string }
46	  | { kind: 'json'; data: string }
47	  | { kind: 'text'; data: string };
48	
49	export function serializeForRedis(value: unknown): RedisLruPayload {
50	  if (Buffer.isBuffer(value) || value instanceof Uint8Array) {
51	    const buf = Buffer.isBuffer(value) ? value : Buffer.from(value);
52	    return { kind: 'buffer', data: buf.toString('base64') };
53	  }
54	  if (typeof value === 'string') {
55	    return { kind: 'text', data: value };
56	  }
57	  return { kind: 'json', data: JSON.stringify(value) };
58	}
59	
60	export function deserializeFromRedis<T>(payload: RedisLruPayload): T {
61	  if (payload.kind === 'buffer') {
62	    return Buffer.from(payload.data, 'base64') as T;
63	  }
64	  if (payload.kind === 'text') {
65	    return payload.data as T;
66	  }
67	  return JSON.parse(payload.data) as T;
68	}
69	
70	let redisClient: Redis | null = null;
71	let redisInitFailed = false;
72	
73	export function isRedisLruConfigured(): boolean {
74	  return Boolean(process.env.REDIS_URL?.trim());
75	}
76	
77	export async function getRedisLruClient(): Promise<Redis | null> {
78	  const url = process.env.REDIS_URL?.trim();
79	  if (!url || redisInitFailed) return null;
80	
81	  if (redisClient) return redisClient;
82	
83	  try {
84	    const { default: Redis } = await import('ioredis');
85	    redisClient = new Redis(url, {
86	      maxRetriesPerRequest: 2,
87	      enableReadyCheck: true,
88	    });
89	    return redisClient;
90	  } catch (error) {
91	    redisInitFailed = true;
92	    console.warn('[redis-lru] No se pudo conectar; solo caché en memoria.', error);
93	    return null;
94	  }
95	}
96	
97	export class RedisLruStore {
98	  private readonly config: LruStoreConfig;
99	
100	  constructor(config: Partial<LruStoreConfig> = {}) {
101	    this.config = { ...getLruStoreConfigFromEnv(), ...config };
102	  }
103	
104	  async get<T>(namespace: string, key: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
105	    const redis = await getRedisLruClient();
106	    if (!redis) return undefined;
107	
108	    const vKey = valueKey(namespace, key);
109	    const raw = await redis.get(vKey);
110	    if (!raw) return undefined;
111	
112	    const now = Date.now();
113	    await redis
114	      .multi()
115	      .zadd(indexKey(namespace), now, key)
116	      .expire(vKey, Math.ceil(this.config.defaultTtlMs / 1000))
117	      .exec();
118	
119	    try {
120	      const payload = JSON.parse(raw) as RedisLruPayload;
121	      return deserializeFromRedis<T>(payload);
122	    } catch {
123	      return undefined;
124	    }
125	  }
126	
127	  async set(
128	    namespace: string,
129	    key: string,
130	    value: unknown,
131	    options: LruSetOptions = {}
132	  ): Promise<void> {
133	    const redis = await getRedisLruClient();
134	    if (!redis) return;
135	
136	    const ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? this.config.defaultTtlMs;
137	    const ttlSec = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ttlMs / 1000));
138	    const vKey = valueKey(namespace, key);
139	    const iKey = indexKey(namespace);
140	    const payload = JSON.stringify(serializeForRedis(value));
141	    const now = Date.now();
142	
143	    await redis
144	      .multi()
145	      .set(vKey, payload, 'EX', ttlSec)
146	      .zadd(iKey, now, key)
147	      .exec();
148	
149	    await this.evictIfNeeded(redis, namespace);
150	  }
151	
152	  private async evictIfNeeded(redis: Redis, namespace: string): Promise<void> {
153	    const iKey = indexKey(namespace);
154	    const count = await redis.zcard(iKey);
155	    const cap = maxEntriesFor(namespace);
156	    const overflow = count - cap;
157	    if (overflow <= 0) return;
158	
159	    const victims = await redis.zpopmin(iKey, overflow);
160	    if (!victims?.length) return;
161	
162	    const pipeline = redis.pipeline();
163	    for (let i = 0; i < victims.length; i += 2) {
164	      const victimKey = victims[i] as string;
165	      pipeline.del(valueKey(namespace, victimKey));
166	    }
167	    await pipeline.exec();
168	  }
169	
170	  async delete(namespace: string, key: string): Promise<void> {
171	    const redis = await getRedisLruClient();
172	    if (!redis) return;
173	    await redis
174	      .multi()
175	      .del(valueKey(namespace, key))
176	      .zrem(indexKey(namespace), key)
177	      .exec();
178	  }
179	
180	  async clearNamespace(namespace: string): Promise<void> {
181	    const redis = await getRedisLruClient();
182	    if (!redis) return;
183	
184	    const iKey = indexKey(namespace);
185	    const members = await redis.zrange(iKey, 0, -1);
186	    if (members.length) {
187	      const pipeline = redis.pipeline();
188	      for (const member of members) {
189	        pipeline.del(valueKey(namespace, member));
190	      }
191	      pipeline.del(iKey);
192	      await pipeline.exec();
193	    } else {
194	      await redis.del(iKey);
195	    }
196	  }
197	
198	  async stats(namespace: string): Promise<LruStats | null> {
199	    const redis = await getRedisLruClient();
200	    if (!redis) return null;
201	    const size = await redis.zcard(indexKey(namespace));
202	    const cap = maxEntriesFor(namespace);
203	    const policy = getCacheNamespacePolicy(namespace as CacheNamespace);
204	    return {
205	      namespace,
206	      size,
207	      calculatedSize: 0,
208	      maxEntries: cap,
209	      maxSizeBytes: policy.maxSizeBytes,
210	    };
211	  }
212	}
213

10	export const runtime = 'nodejs';

12	/**
13	 * GET /api/web-pages/validate-demo-url
14	 * Query: demoUrl | id | slug | all=1
15	 */
16	export async function GET(request: Request) {
17	  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
18	  const all = searchParams.get('all') === '1' || searchParams.get('all') === 'true';
19	
20	  if (all) {
21	    const pages = getRawWebPages();
22	    const results = await Promise.all(
23	      pages.map(async (page) => {
24	        const validation = await validateDemoUrl(
25	          page.demoUrl ?? '',
26	          page.stack ?? []
27	        );
28	        return {
29	          id: page.id,
30	          stack: page.stack ?? [],
31	          demoUrl: page.demoUrl ?? '',
32	          ...validation,
33	        };
34	      })
35	    );
36	
37	    const invalid = results.filter(r => !r.valid && r.status !== 'prompt-only');
38	
39	    return compressedJsonResponse(request, {
40	      total: results.length,
41	      valid: results.filter(r => r.valid).length,
42	      promptOnly: results.filter(r => r.status === 'prompt-only').length,
43	      invalid: invalid.length,
44	      results,
45	    });
46	  }
47	
48	  const hasDemoUrl = searchParams.has('demoUrl');
49	  const demoUrlParam = searchParams.get('demoUrl');
50	  const id = searchParams.get('id');
51	  const slug = searchParams.get('slug');
52	
53	  let demoUrl = '';
54	
55	  if (hasDemoUrl) {
56	    demoUrl = demoUrlParam?.trim() ?? '';
57	  } else if (id) {
58	    const page = getRawWebPageById(id);
59	    if (!page) {
60	      return NextResponse.json(
61	        { error: `Entrada no encontrada en web-pages.json: id=${id}` },
62	        { status: 404 }
63	      );
64	    }
65	    demoUrl = page.demoUrl?.trim() ?? '';
66	  } else if (slug) {
67	    const page = getRawWebPageByDemoSlug(slug);
68	    if (!page) {

71	        { status: 404 }
72	      );
73	    }
74	    demoUrl = page.demoUrl?.trim() ?? '';
75	  }
76	
77	  if (!hasDemoUrl && !id && !slug) {
78	    return NextResponse.json(
79	      {

81	          'Indica demoUrl, id, slug o all=1 para validar entradas de web-pages.json',

41	export async function GET() {
42	  const { userId } = await auth();
43	  if (!userId) return jsonResponse(FREE);
44	
45	  const client = await clerkClient();
46	  const user = await client.users.getUser(userId);
47	  const meta = user.privateMetadata as Partial<StripeUserMetadata>;
48	
49	  // Fast path — ya tenemos el customer ID almacenado desde el webhook
50	  if (meta.stripeCustomerId) {
51	    const { data: subs } = await stripe.subscriptions.list({
52	      customer: meta.stripeCustomerId,
53	      status: 'active',
54	      limit: 1,
55	    });
56	
57	    if (subs.length === 0) return jsonResponse(FREE);
58	
59	    const fresh = extractSubscriptionMeta(subs[0], meta.stripeCustomerId, meta.stripePlan ?? 'premium');
60	    return jsonResponse(toResponse(fresh));
61	  }
62	
63	  // Slow path — buscar por email del usuario en Stripe
64	  const email = user.emailAddresses[0]?.emailAddress;
65	  if (!email) return jsonResponse(FREE);
66	
67	  const { data: customers } = await stripe.customers.list({ email, limit: 5 });
68	  if (customers.length === 0) return jsonResponse(FREE);
69	
70	  for (const customer of customers) {
71	    const { data: subs } = await stripe.subscriptions.list({
72	      customer: customer.id,
73	      status: 'active',
74	      limit: 1,
75	    });
76	
77	    if (subs.length === 0) continue;
78	
79	    const sub = subs[0] as Stripe.Subscription;
80	    const freshMeta = extractSubscriptionMeta(sub, customer.id, 'premium');
81	
82	    // Guardar en Clerk para que las próximas llamadas usen el fast path
83	    await client.users.updateUserMetadata(userId, { privateMetadata: freshMeta });
84	
85	    // Taggear el customer en Stripe con el clerkUserId para que el webhook funcione
86	    if (!customer.metadata?.clerkUserId) {
87	      await stripe.customers.update(customer.id, { metadata: { clerkUserId: userId } });
88	    }
89	
90	    return jsonResponse(toResponse(freshMeta));
91	  }
92	
93	  return jsonResponse(FREE);
94	}

I need to implement a Token Bucket rate limiting algorithm. Since Redis is already available, I can use it to implement the Token Bucket algorithm across multiple server instances.

The Token Bucket algorithm works like this:
1. Each "bucket" (per IP or per user) has a maximum capacity of tokens
2. Tokens are added at a constant rate (e.g., 10 tokens per 10 seconds)


3. Each request consumes one token
4. If no tokens are available, the request is rejected with 429 Too Many Requests

For the implementation, I'll create a Redis-backed Token Bucket utility with an in-memory fallback, then wrap it in a middleware helper that can be applied to routes like `/api/like` for POST mutations that need rate limiting.
